trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Auri-El Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Auri-El's Dawn" Body: "You held the path through a world built to make you forget it. The return is not a doctrine to you; it is a daily practice. Keep walking toward the dawn. I am the dawn."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Auri-El Devoted + dawn observance; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: The dawn answers you, and the return feels near.

deity_tone: Magnus: Precise, scholarly, escape-coded; the architect who got out; speaks of the Elder Way and of the arts as the road.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Magnus Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Elder Way" Body: "I did not break the trap with force. I studied until the wall became a door. You have studied as I studied. The arts are the road, and you are far along it."

deity_tone: Magnus: Precise, scholarly, escape-coded; the architect who got out; speaks of the Elder Way and of the arts as the road.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Magnus Devoted + magic skill milestone; per milestone.

deity_tone: Trinimac: Stern, militant, civilizational; speaks of the project defended by force and orthodoxy held; the martial ancestor.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Trinimac Devoted; Entry-only.
draft_prose: Title: "Trinimac's Sword" Body: "The project does not defend itself. You have defended it -- by force, by orthodoxy held without flinching. The Lorkhan world strikes hardest at those who strike hardest for me. You did not yield."

deity_tone: Xarxes: Dry, archival, lineage-keeping; speaks of what is written, the genealogy, the quiet truth that outlasts enforcement.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Xarxes Devoted; Entry-only.
draft_prose: Title: "Xarxes' Record" Body: "Enforcement forgets. The record does not. You have kept faith with the lineage and the written truth. Your name is set down where it cannot be unwritten."

deity_tone: Syrabane: Gentle, guardian-toned, warding; the apprentices' protector; speaks of the magic that shields the one still on the path.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Syrabane Devoted; Entry-only.
draft_prose: Title: "Syrabane's Ward" Body: "The path is long and the one who walks it can fall. I have shielded apprentices since the first of them. I shield you now. Walk on, and walk warded."

trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Auri-El's Path" Body: "You have kept the dawn through every temptation to forget it. Make the return your focus, and the foundation becomes the whole of your faith. Will you name me?"

deity_tone: Magnus: Precise, scholarly, escape-coded; the architect who got out; speaks of the Elder Way and of the arts as the road.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Magnus and the Elder Way" Body: "You study as escape, not as utility. That is my path. Name me your focus, and the arts become the road back. Will you?"

deity_tone: Trinimac: Stern, militant, civilizational; speaks of the project defended by force and orthodoxy held; the martial ancestor.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown; requires ThalmorAlignment 70+.
draft_prose: Title: "Trinimac's Call" Body: "You have defended the project with the sword, not only the prayer. The orthodox path is the hardest, and the Lorkhan world will strike you hardest for it. Name me, and carry that weight."

deity_tone: Xarxes: Dry, archival, lineage-keeping; speaks of what is written, the genealogy, the quiet truth that outlasts enforcement.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Xarxes and the Record" Body: "You trust what is written over what is enforced. Name me your focus, and the lineage and the quiet truth become your devotion. Will you?"

deity_tone: Syrabane: Gentle, guardian-toned, warding; the apprentices' protector; speaks of the magic that shields the one still on the path.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Syrabane's Guard" Body: "You cast to shield, not only to strike. Name me your focus, and the warding arts become your path. Will you walk it guarded?"

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire; terminal -- no restoration arc.
draft_prose: Title: "Auri-El Closes" Body: "You flee the sun now, and the sun is the god of return. There is no path back from where you stand. The records will not hold your name. This is not a punishment. It is what shrinking from the dawn has always meant."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation; devotion halts entirely.
draft_prose: Title: "The Project Inverted" Body: "The whole of Altmer faith is to become spirit again. You have become a beast. There is no doctrine for this, no heresy small enough to hold it, no path in any direction. Devotion stops here."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time, first Lorkhan pressure of any tier.
draft_prose: Title: "The Old Dissonance" Body: "Lorkhan made the mortal world, the trap your ancestors fell into. Acts that honor, strengthen, or celebrate his creation press against your faith -- not because a god disapproves, but because you have touched the thing that broke your people. You will feel this again."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Auri-El Devoted.
draft_prose: "I keep the dawn and the path back. Speak of the return."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Magnus or Syrabane focus; College context.
draft_prose: "The arts are my devotion. Show me what the College keeps closed."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Trinimac Devoted; ThalmorAlignment 70+.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Dawn rite after Lorkhan pressure or crisis; one per day.
draft_prose: The dawn holds. The dissonance settles for now.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Three coherent days; no contradictory major signal.
draft_prose: Your acts still make one shape. The path holds.

trigger: MessageBox. High alignment plus costly, curated enforcement only.
draft_prose: Title: "Orthodoxy Held" Body: "This was not obedience for its own sake. You defended the project where compromise would have been easier. The old order recognizes the cost."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Moderate alignment held through a real choice.
draft_prose: Neither zeal nor collapse. The middle path remains yours.

trigger: MessageBox. Major crisis resolved through study/self-cultivation.
draft_prose: Title: "Doubt Given Shape" Body: "You did not flee the contradiction. You studied it until it became a path you could walk. The old doubt quiets, not because it is gone, but because it is understood."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Auri-El focused crisis resolution or dawn rite.
draft_prose: Auri-El's dawn does not erase the scar. It shows the way through.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Record/lineage/truth preserved; one-shot marker.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Protection milestone, apprentice aid, anti-mage survival.
draft_prose: The ward held when it mattered. Syrabane was near.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time; starts `Dissonant`.
draft_prose: Title: "Named By The Mortal Story" Body: "The world has named you Dragonborn. To Skyrim, this is glory. To Altmer faith, it is a mortal story closing around you. The path is not broken, but it has become harder to hold."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time; strongest crisis flavor.
draft_prose: Title: "Shor's Hall Is Real" Body: "You have stood where Altmer doctrine would rather not look. Shor's dead have a hall, and its bridge had a guardian. This does not answer your faith. It wounds it with evidence."

trigger: MessageBox. Costly Talos aid, shrine protection, or hypocrisy proof only.
draft_prose: Title: "The Forbidden Question" Body: "Talos should be simple. Heresy. Usurpation. A mortal lie. Yet the world keeps offering evidence that simplicity cannot hold. What you do next will decide whether this becomes doubt or repair."

trigger: MessageBox. Companions, Wuuthrad, or nearby beast pressure; curse hard halt overrides.
draft_prose: Title: "Ysgramor's Shadow" Body: "The old human war story has touched you. Honor, beast-blood, Wuuthrad, Shor's people -- none of it is neutral to an Altmer soul. You can pass through it, but not without naming what it cost."

trigger: MessageBox. Optional enhancement after vampire onset; Tier 1 cap only.
draft_prose: Title: "Exile From The Dawn" Body: "Auri-El is closed while you flee the sun. Still, an Altmer does not become nothing because the records cast them out. What remains is exile: a narrow discipline, a name kept privately, never a full return."

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You are exiled from the dawn, not restored to it. A thin discipline remains, capped low, held only by refusal to collapse.
